## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

WatchRaceComplicationDataSourceService — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/race/WatchRaceComplicationDataSourceService.kt

## Trigger

The system calling onComplicationRequest to refresh the watch face's
complication — observed

## Today

`onComplicationRequest` reads `raceRecordingRepository.findInProgress()`
directly and, when a race is in progress, reads `navigator.current.value`
to build the tap intent's destination. That first access triggers
`WatchRaceNavigator`'s lazy initialiser (`WatchRaceNavigator.kt`), which
launches, on its own `CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Default)`
with no exception handler, the asynchronous reads `NavigationModule.kt`
wires: `raceRecordingRepository.findInProgress()` and
`profileRepository.observe().first()`, the latter wrapped only in
`withTimeoutOrNull` — which resolves `false` on a timeout but does not
catch a thrown failure. This whole path runs whether or not
`MainActivity` has ever been created, since the complication data source
service is bound and queried by the system independently of any
activity. A failure surfacing from `profileRepository.observe()` (an
unwrapped `Flow<Profile>`, not a `Result`-carrying boundary) propagates
uncaught out of the launched coroutine, with no activity, no screen and
no state holder able to catch or render it — crashing the hosting
system service instead of leaving the complication showing nothing.

## Expected

`onComplicationRequest` never lets a source failure escape the service
as an uncaught exception: whatever `WatchRaceNavigator`'s lazy
initialiser triggers on first access resolves to a value the service can
read, and a failure there — once `NavigationModule`'s reads emit their
failure as a value instead of throwing, per the correction on the
profile source and the state that carries it — leads the service to
call `listener.onComplicationData(null)`, exactly as the no-race-in-
progress case already does, rather than let the coroutine terminate the
process. This is specific to the complication path: it has no activity
and no screen to fall back on, so the empty data source is its own
degraded state.
